changes.evidence: The name 'Typhoid Mary' is never said on screen in Iron Fist; the character is only 'Mary' and 'Walker' (fandom aliases list only those; 'Typhoid Mary' appears only in the comics note). In S2#5 Wing and Knight find Joy with Walker and overpower her after a brief skirmish.

now.title: Iron Fist S2#8
now.text: Walker admits she compiled a dossier on Ward Meachum for Joy, but Ward strikes a deal with her: he pays for her redacted military files, and she agrees to go after Davos.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Joy's brother, who pays for Mary's files in return for help against Davos.

proposed.text: Ward strikes a deal with Walker, who once compiled a dossier on him for Joy: he gets her redacted military file, and she agrees to help protect Joy from Davos.

changes.evidence: Walker admits the dossier on Ward in S2#6 (The Dragon Dies at Dawn), when Ward asks if she told Joy about his NA meetings, not in S2#8. In S2#8 Ward agrees to get her redacted file if she helps protect Joy from Davos.

changes.evidence: 'Walker's other personalities' (plural) points to a third alter, which Walker only deduces in S2#8 and considers in S2#10. In S2#5 Joy simply hires Walker for protection from Davos.
